description:
Use this when you need an auditable South Africa national working-day count. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when you need employer, school, bank, exchange or locally exchanged schedules.
What it computes: Counts national working and non-working dates in a South Africa 2026-2027 range.
Example user requests: Count South Africa working days from 2026-11-03 to 2026-11-06.
Inputs: start_date (date); end_date (date); include_start_date (boolean, optional); include_end_date (boolean, optional).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2026-11-03","end_date":"2026-11-06","include_start_date":true,"include_end_date":true}
Outputs: working_days, non_working_days, public_holidays_counted, territory, territory_name, holiday_names, calendar_scope, employer_schedule_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: for each included date: working_days += South Africa status.is_working_day
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/south-africa-working-days-between with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/south-africa-working-days-between.md
name: count_south_africa_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: National public holidays over a Monday-Friday baseline.

employer_schedule_policy.description: Employer-specific exchanges and rest days are not inferred.

holiday_names.description: National public holidays applying on the date.

non_working_days.description: Weekend and exact national public holiday dates.

public_holidays_counted.description: Exact national events in the range.

sources.description: Official South African Government, legislation and Presidency sources.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Count South Africa Working Days
